title: Cam Inter-Story Handoff
description: Machine-readable state transfer between cam story iterations. Written after completing a story, read at the start of the next.

lastCompletedStory.description: The story that was just completed

branchName.description: Git branch name from the PRD

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the handoff was written

modifiedFiles.description: Existing files modified during this story

openQuestions.description: Unresolved questions or decisions deferred to a future story

nextStoryContext.description: Free-text context the next story iteration should know about — gotchas, dependencies, or setup needed

officialDocsValidated.description: Result of Step 5.5 (see .claude/commands/cam-next.md) — one entry per external library cross-checked against its current official docs.

lib.description: Library / service name. Use literal 'none' when status='no_external_lib_touched'.

url.description: Exact docs URL that was fetched. Omit when status='no_external_lib_touched'.

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the fetch. Omit when status='no_external_lib_touched'.

status.description: aligned: code matches current docs. corrected: code was misaligned and fixed during Step 5.5. no_external_lib_touched: pure refactor/copy/doc/harness story. fetch_failed: fetch failed — reviewer re-checks at PR time.

summary.description: Optional one-line note about what was checked/aligned/corrected.
